rehearsalNote: This record is the seeded, fail-closed tabletop rehearsal for the validator. Before a real mainnet GO, the release lead must replace the role-based reviewer handles with named independent reviewers and re-attest every scenario against fresh evidence; the validator itself does not execute infrastructure.

baseline.before: No signed go/no-go tabletop, no required scenario set, no independent reviewer enforcement, and no machine-checkable decision record.
baseline.after: Seven mandatory scenarios, six independent reviewer areas, blocker/staleness/evidence checks, and a deterministic GO/NO_GO record that fails closed in CI.

recovery: NO_GO: resolve the listed blocker(s), attach fresh repository-local evidence, obtain new independent Signed review, update this record, and rerun the gate.

scenarios.expectedControl: Anchor/price oracle outage must halt new funding and prevent insolvent invoice acceptance.
scenarios.observedResult: Oracle rollback and containment drill keeps funding blocked until a healthy anchor feed returns.
scenarios.recoveryPath: Freeze new funding, restore the last known-good oracle feed, and replay the drill before resuming.

scenarios.expectedControl: Concurrent LP withdrawals must not block settlement or breach liquidity coverage.
scenarios.observedResult: Stress scenario stays within the documented treasury coverage and withdrawal containment limits.
scenarios.recoveryPath: Throttle withdrawals, draw the liquidity buffer, and re-run the stress scenario before GO.

scenarios.expectedControl: Emergency pause and unpause paths must be reachable, authorized, and reversible.
scenarios.observedResult: Feature-disable/kill-switch paths behave as documented and preserve an auditable trail.
scenarios.recoveryPath: Keep the contract paused, restore the authorized operator path, and re-rehearse unpause.

scenarios.expectedControl: A stalled or corrupt indexer cursor must be recoverable within the documented RTO.
scenarios.observedResult: Replay reproduces state within the recorded recovery-time objective.
scenarios.recoveryPath: Restore from WAL snapshot, replay from the last good ledger, and verify cursor parity.

scenarios.expectedControl: Notification provider failure must trigger fallback and dead-letter replay without duplicate delivery.
scenarios.observedResult: Provider outage replay stays within the notification recovery SLO with deduplicated delivery.
scenarios.recoveryPath: Open the circuit, drain the DLQ after provider recovery, and verify no duplicate sends.

scenarios.expectedControl: Unauthorized or malformed configuration changes must be rejected before deployment.
scenarios.observedResult: Readiness review controls reject poisoned config and preserve the owned recovery path.
scenarios.recoveryPath: Revert the release to the last signed configuration and rerun the readiness gate.

scenarios.expectedControl: A governance veto must block the release path and leave an auditable decision trail.
scenarios.observedResult: Wave-9 operations controls retain the veto/block decision and an owner for recovery.
scenarios.recoveryPath: Honour the veto, record the blocking finding, and re-run the tabletop only after resolution.
